exposure: uterine artery embolization (UAE) for postpartum hemorrhage (PPH)
outcome: Rate of PPH in subsequent pregnancies
cohort: 77 patients treated by UAE for PPH and 189 matched patients without PPH
finding: Patients treated with UAE for PPH had similar gynecological and sexual outcomes to controls, but a longer inter-pregnancy interval, lower success rate of subsequent pregnancy, and higher rate of PPH in subsequent pregnancies.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was a matching criteria for cases and controls in this study examining long-term outcomes after uterine artery embolization.
